reviewTitle: Really great earplugs, keychain case is clutch.
reviewDescription: My 4 year old has a sensitivity to loud sounds. Even the automatic toilets in a public restroom are too much for him. He loves baseball games but when the crowd cheers it scares him, so we ordered these earplugs to bring him some relief. He’s quite particular about his body, so I wasn’t sure if he would allow me to help him with these. It was nice to let him choose a color when we discussed these before ordering, and we let him squish the earplug between his fingers to see how soft they are. I was surprised and grateful that a small keychain case was included, and really came in handy when we went to a movie and the volume was overwhelming for our little guy. They went in effortlessly and stayed for the entire duration of the movie, so they must be comfortable. 10/10 will be ordering again.

reviewDescription: I bought these for the left ear. I guess I got some weird Frankenstein’s ears or something because the right ear can use the regular ones and the left has to have the smaller ones. 🤷🏼♀️ They are the most comfortable ones I’ve ever used. I’m a rotisserie turning side sleeper and these do stay in place. Sometimes my ears can get a bit sore after wearing them all night. I’d rather have the sore ears vs. listening to my husband break the sound barrier with his snores. These do not block the sound completely but they do mute it. Instead of hearing my husband trying to imitate an F-35 fighter jet it sounds more like a muted Boss 302.

reviewTitle: Good for smaller ears and actually comfortable to wear
reviewDescription: These are a good option if you need earplugs for smaller ears. That really seems to be the main point here, and that is what makes them stand out. Regular earplugs can feel too big or fall out, but these are sized better for kids or adults with smaller ear canals. They are soft and comfortable, which matters a lot because if earplugs are annoying, nobody is going to keep them in. These seem better for sleeping, travel, concerts, or other loud situations where you just want to bring the noise down. I also like that they come with a small case, because that makes them easier to carry around and keep clean. The main thing with foam earplugs like this is you still have to insert them properly, otherwise they will not seal as well as they should. But once they are in right, they do a good job reducing noise without being too harsh or uncomfortable. Overall, a good choice for kids or anyone with smaller ears who needs soft, comfortable earplugs that actually fit better than standard ones.
